rationale: High-end landscaping and tree surgery demands a premium, nature-oriented approach. We avoid generic SaaS styles, opting instead for a 'luxury botanical magazine' aesthetic that inspires profound trust and professional authority.

headings.description: Used exclusively for large headings. Brings editorial elegance and premium artisanal feel.

body.description: Used for paragraphs, buttons, and functional UI text. Ensures strict legibility and modern structure.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-serif font-light tracking-tighter text-[#0A0F0D] leading-none
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-[#0A0F0D] leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h3: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-medium text-[#1F3D2B] leading-snug
hierarchy.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-[#1F3D2B]

rules: Headings strictly bounded to max text-6xl to avoid cartoonish proportions.
Always apply tracking-tight to headings and tracking-[0.2em] to overlines.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale). E1 Strategy: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs to create 'breathing room' and a luxurious gallery feel.
layout_and_spacing.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12

surface_treatments.premium_card: bg-white p-8 lg:p-12 border border-[#E5E0D5] shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] rounded-2xl

buttons.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-[#1F3D2B] text-[#FDFBF7] px-8 py-4 rounded-full font-sans font-semibold text-base transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-[#14281C] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1F3D2B] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#FDFBF7]
buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-[#F2EBD9] text-[#1F3D2B] px-8 py-4 rounded-full font-sans font-semibold text-base transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-[#E6DBBF] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md border border-[#1F3D2B]/10
buttons.outline: inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-transparent text-[#1F3D2B] px-8 py-4 rounded-full font-sans font-semibold text-base border-2 border-[#1F3D2B] transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-[#1F3D2B] hover:text-[#FDFBF7]

header.structure: Split/Double logo structure. Left: Les Jardiniers Normands. Right side or inline: Pro Elagage 14 badge.

interactive.before_after_slider: Use a robust before/after visual component. Implement with a draggable handle (left=before, right=after). Frame it in a premium container with rounded-2xl.
interactive.floating_cta: Mobile-first floating action buttons in bottom right (Phone & WhatsApp). Display gracefully on desktop.
interactive.testimonial_cards: Minimalist UI, prominent 5-star Lucide icons (text-yellow-500), displaying customer name and high-contrast text.

motion_and_interactions.reveal: Use framer-motion. `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}` to `animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`. Transition: `duration: 0.6, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]`.
motion_and_interactions.hover_cards: Subtle lift (`-translate-y-1` or `-translate-y-2`) with expanded ambient shadow.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Apply light parallax (`y` mapping on scroll) to hero background images and floating decorative elements.

hero.overlay_instructions: Maximum overlay bg-black/30 or gradient to transparent. Must ensure text contrast without killing image vibrancy.

seo_and_structure_requirements: Strictly follow semantic HTML (nav, main, section, article, footer, h1-h6 hierarchy).
Include LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema with Calvados coverage (Caen, Deauville, etc.).
Implement an SEO FAQ accordion using Shadcn Accordion component if available, styled to match the premium theme.
Internal linking footer with links to all 11 service pages and 12 city pages.
technical_testing_rules: ALL interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
iconography: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Stroke width strictly 1.5 for elegance. Recommended: Leaf, Trees, ShieldCheck (for EEAT), Phone, MapPin, CheckCircle2.
